title: feat(planck-to-now): adopt the landing's ink catalogue system
GPGPU particle physics: ping-pong FBO simulation replaces the vertex-shader crossfade
summary: Particles now integrate on the GPU every frame: positions+velocities in float ping-pong targets, curl-noise turbulence scaled by the plasma era, spring accretion toward the cosmic-web targets, damped settle. Click perturbs the field (shock ripple in plasma, gravity well in web era); big timeline scrubs and R reseed the state textures; ?static=1 keeps the old vertex-shader path as fallback; HUD gained a gpgpu/fps line. Smoke test (tests/browser-smoke.mjs, npm run test:smoke) covers gpgpu, fallback, scrub, poke, mobile — and caught that .hud pointer-events:none disabled timeline scrubbing in the shipped build (fixed). Verified: verify + test:smoke green; epoch screenshots reviewed at 1440.
